description: Unit test class for EmployeeLanguageDao's functionality within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin, testing CRUD operations and data retrieval methods related to employee languages.

classes.name: EmployeeLanguageDaoTest
classes.description: Test suite for EmployeeLanguageDao, verifying CRUD operations, search filters, and allowed language retrieval specific to employee profiles within the HRMS.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes EmployeeLanguageDao instance and populates test data from fixture before each test.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeLanguage
methods.description: Tests saving a new employee language and verifies the persisted data matches expected values.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeLanguage
methods.description: Tests retrieval of an employee language by identifiers and asserts retrieved data correctness and null handling for nonexistent entries.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeLanguages
methods.description: Verifies search filter correctly fetches employee language data based on employee number.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeLanguagesCount
methods.description: Checks the accuracy of the total count of employee languages matching certain filters.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeLanguagesWithLanguageIds
methods.description: Tests filtering employee languages by multiple language IDs.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeLanguages
methods.description: Validates deletion of specific employee language entries and counts deletions.

methods.name: testGetAllowedEmployeeLanguages
methods.description: Ensures retrieval of allowed languages for a specific employee, including cases with no explicit restrictions.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeAllowedLicensesCount
methods.description: Verifies the count of allowed languages for given employee filter.
